name: Using Profanity
overview: Scripture instructs believers to honor God in their speech by avoiding profane and deceitful language, as taking the Lord's name in vain is expressly forbidden (Exodus 20:7). The psalmist prays for words and meditations that are pleasing to God, emphasizing the importance of guarding the tongue from evil and guile (Psalms 19:14; 34:13). Wisdom literature further urges putting away corrupt and perverse speech, highlighting that controlling one's mouth preserves the soul from trouble (Proverbs 4:24; 21:23). Ultimately, these verses call for vigilance over our words, trusting God to help keep our lips from sin (Psalms 141:3).
